description:
The current test only checks for positive matches (Console.ReadLine found, File.WriteAllText found, etc.). There are no assertions that things like `Console.ReadLine` don't appear in unexpected places, or that the AST structure is correct for specific constructs.

Fix: Add assertions that:
- Type definitions produce `ITypeDef` items
- Open statements produce `IImport` items
- Constants produce `IConstant` items
- Functions produce `IFunction` items
- The item count matches expectations (22 items for sample.fs)
title: F# mapper: add negative test cases
